featured_reviews.name: Shaun James
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was charged ₹892 for a haircut by a stylist who was introduced as a "specialist" / "semi-specialist." Based on the result, that description was extremely generous. The haircut looks rushed, lacks any real shape or refinement, and the back has been left looking blunt and awkward.

The final result honestly resembles a basic school haircut rather than something done by a stylist charging specialist rates.
What makes this worse is the feeling that customers are being misled. If someone is new or still learning, that's perfectly fine. Everyone starts somewhere. But presenting them as a specialist and charging accordingly is unfair to customers who are paying for experience and expertise.

I didn't walk in expecting perfection. I did expect a haircut that justified the price and the way the stylist was marketed. Instead, I walked out wondering what exactly the extra money was for.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but the gap between what was promised and what was delivered was ridiculous. If this is what "expert styling" looks like, I'd strongly recommend saving your money and going elsewhere

I've honestly had far better haircuts at local salons for less than ₹500, where the staff were more skilled and far more professional.

Worst.experience.ever.
